integrity: The critical polynomial certificate, difference equation, and classical parameter reductions were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. The 2000 same-object bifurcation analysis was inspected in full through the authors' public HTML version. Literature noncoverage claims are limited to material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not classify unbounded trajectories.
It forces visits above the nonzero-equilibrium height but does not by itself force visits below that height.
It does not prove existence of nontrivial compact recurrence throughout the stated parameter region.
The complete 2003 trajectory-analysis article was unavailable in the inspected sources; its abstract advertises a potentially related Poincare-crossing theorem.
Targeted searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older stationary identities.
title: Conditional stationary laws and an exact equilibrium-height defect in the Chen system
